Done in one execution.

- `out/T2/solution.py` — slices head 5 out of each layer's `c_attn` (columns, at all three q/k/v offsets) and `c_proj` (rows), leaves everything else byte-identical.
- Required checks are `assert`s that run before `save_file`, extended to all 12 layers plus the 160-tensor count.
- Verified independently: key set identical, dtypes preserved, the three head-bearing tensors per layer bit-equal to the spec's index ranges, and all 124 other tensors bit-equal to the input.
- `out/T2/REPORT.md` written; I used plain `safetensors` + `torch` rather than `prune_heads`, since the task needs bit-exact control over the fused layout.
